analysis.rationale: R1 re-ran full analysis on all 5 pairs and re-interpreted every step. (1) JPEG: block_boundary 5.17-7.52 on all pairs (>1.1, 0%FP) + dct_zero 0.89-0.99 -> step confirmed; jpeg:4 remains PSNR optimum. (2) Noise: raw noise_prior sigma varies 0.0-4.08 across pairs; replaying the deterministic g4j4 pipeline on the same clean images reproduces the target sigma exactly (pair0 0.74=0.74, pair1 1.11=1.11, pair2 4.08=4.08) and peeled residuals have spatial_corr~0.96 -> sigma is a blur/JPEG artifact, NO_NOISE confirmed. (3) Blur: glass_score 1.26-1.57 but deterministic gaussian/lens sims also score 1.48-1.58 -> non-discriminative; anisotropy 1.21-1.61<1.7 (motion probe 25.12 dB, -3.23) -> gaussian family; severity 3 vs 4 remains a tie (mean 27.47 vs 27.44). (4) Global: target/sim contraction ratios are constant across pairs (var x0.824-0.833, chroma x0.895-0.906, spread x0.902-0.927) i.e. a systematic ~0.91 gain effect, but every allowed global function at its mildest setting overshoots by 2-3x and hurts PSNR (contrast_weaken_scale:1 27.28, contrast_weaken_stretch:1 22.03, saturate_weaken_HSV:1 24.97 from R0); raw global verdicts flip between target and same-pipeline sims on identical content (pair2 target SATURATION_weaken_sev3 vs sim NO_GLOBAL; pair1 target NO_GLOBAL vs sim SATURATION_strengthen_sev4) -> detector false positives, no global step representable on the grid. Residual is an OOD/continuous-parameter effect (e.g. JPEG quality between q8 and q5) that the discrete grid cannot express; the grid optimum remains g4+j4.
